metadata.changelog:
First release for Forge 1.20.1.

- In-game attribute screen: keybind `K` or `/customattributes`
- Slider, exact value input and per-attribute reset
- Whitelist / blacklist mode with 19 preset attributes
- Range expressions with `current`, `base`, `default`, `min`, `max`, `inf` and arithmetic
- Adjustments lock to the chosen value, so equipment and potion changes do not pull it away
- Requires forgeattachment 0.0.1-1.20.1+build.0 or newer

---

首个 Forge 1.20.1 版本。

- 游戏内属性调整界面：按键 `K` 或 `/customattributes`
- 滑块、精确数值输入与逐项重置
- 白名单 / 黑名单模式，预置 19 个常见属性
- 范围表达式支持 `current`、`base`、`default`、`min`、`max`、`inf` 与四则运算
- 调整锁定在玩家选定的值上，装备与药水变化不会把它带走
- 需要 forgeattachment 0.0.1-1.20.1+build.0 或更高版本
